title: Circus Site Platform content publishing configuration
description: Site-owned selection of explicitly managed WordPress content, keyed by a stable content key. Structural validation only; scripts/lib/content-publish-config.mjs performs the full boundary validation, including duplicate-key and unsafe-path rejection.

items.description: Managed content items keyed by a stable, WordPress-ID-independent content key.

type.description: How the local item is located.

path.description: Absolute trailing-slash path required by the `page_path` and `post_path` selectors.

artifactDir.description: Site-relative directory holding this item's manifest.json, content file, and optional featured image.

metadata.description: Additional post-meta keys this item may carry. Empty until a real use case needs one.
